chunk.text: Are you happy with the result of the test? Do you feel relieved? The first big team they faced this season, the first big test, was basically to face Bayern Munich at home, which was not even Camp Nou, it was Montjuïc Stadium. It is basically a rented home. To face Bayern Munich at home, with all due respect, they were beaten badly. Bayern was embarrassed. Post-match, Müller was saying that we have put our hands up, we are not ready. Bayern has lost to Aston Villa, and now they have been beaten by Barca. Raphinha scored a hat-trick. Yamal and Pedri’s magic was on display. Are you seeing this? Are you understanding the gravity of the situation? In 2015 was the last time Barca beat Bayern Munich.

That was when Luis Enrique was the head coach. The only two coaches to beat Bayern were Pep Guardiola and Luis Enrique. The third man, Hansi Flick, has now done it. And whenever Barca beat Bayern in such a season, they went on to win the treble. Now I am seeing that the average age of this squad is 24 years and 122 days. Before that, hold on, I want to mention something because again Full Time Store has done something big for me. They sent me a Barca jersey. They sent me a Barca jersey. Full Time Store sent me a jersey. You can get one too, use the PD20 code, link in the description basically.

Go check their site, a lot of people were asking me. Use PD20 as well. Now you know, I am talking nonsense. Look at this photo, please. The average age of this squad is 24 years and 128 days. Who are these guys? Sorry, who are these kids? Today in Barca’s lineup, there were 6 players from the academy. This is not even a super team. You are not able to understand the gravity of the situation at 2 in the night. You are not able to understand, it’s simple. Who is this guy, Casado? 2–3 years ago, who was he? He wouldn’t even have a FIFA card. Nobody knew him. But all of a sudden, he is playing at such a high level.

That he is intercepting the ball against Bayern. He is marking Kane, my friends. It is very important to understand that not only has a revolution been brought to this club with young players and belief in them, but big teams are being dismantled. Raphinha, Pedri, Lamine Yamal. Once upon a time, there was a depressed player going through a rough phase. Now he has been given a new life. Captain’s armband on him. I don’t know what to say, I don’t understand. El Clásico is coming in 3 days. I am not joking, I am going crazy. What happened today, Barca didn’t dominate possession. They had 40% possession and Bayern had 60%.

Their press was high. Bayern were pushing up and not letting Barca play football. Iñigo Martínez, who is a very good footballer, was targeted. They tried to press him onto his left foot so that he couldn’t play progressive passes. Bayern were going man-to-man, pressing high. But one thing is very interesting. Look at Yamal’s positioning here and look at Davies. Davies is marking him. Alphonso Davies is such a top full-back, and I can safely say that Yamal destroyed him in this game. If you watched the game, Yamal completely dominated him.

After that, when he came into the game, Alphonso Davies struggled badly. Gnabry and Davies on that flank were completely exposed. Bayern took a lot of risk in their press. They pressed man-to-man, so Raphinha made intelligent movements. That created dynamism, and suddenly the back three were open. Kimmich was here, Upamecano was here, and they were playing very risky. Yamal was inviting Davies inside, whereas usually he stays wide. From that play, Barca beat the press and scored a goal. The first goal came in just 56 seconds.

So this was how they beat Bayern’s press. This initiative was executed within a minute. After that, it was interesting. Many people are saying this was a very intense game with both teams pressing high. Look where Barca is positioned, very vertically compact. This is what Hansi Flick is doing again and again. He is not hesitating. Whether it is Bayern or Madrid, he sticks to his plan. In a big game, he showed it clearly. When a coach trains something repeatedly, it shows in matches.

To do that against a big team shows belief. If I am a Barca player and my coach tells me this plan, the players trust it. You may ask if it is risky or not. Of course, Bayern were finding spaces. Bayern made a lot of switches. If Bayern had gone long directly, they could have broken Barca’s trap. Barca were closing passing lanes, so Bayern used diagonal switches. They found Olise, used underlaps, and created chances.

Then Olise switched to Gnabry. There were many switches in this game. Bayern made 12 switches in the first half, the most by any team in the Champions League this season. Their plan was clear. Kane was involved, dropping deep and creating play. It looked like Bayern had control. But one thing stood out. Look at Barca’s back line and midfield, how compact they are. The midfield stays very close to the defense.

Hansi Flick’s idea is that even if their high press is broken, the lines remain protected. If they are beaten, the midfielder is close enough, like Casado, to recover and intercept. The midfield plays very close to the back line. Pedri is working extremely hard. Even though he is an artist, he is putting in effort. The team ran a lot in this game. Their shifting and movement were intense. Raphinha scored a goal from a transition after defending a set piece. This kind of hard work is visible from training.

Whatever happens in training is clearly visible in matches, whether against Bayern or Real Madrid in 3 days. Honestly, Barca were not at their absolute best in this game. They allowed space, and Bayern were patient. Müller was very intelligent. But Bayern’s left side with Gnabry struggled. Davies had a poor game and was completely dominated by Yamal.

Bayern’s midfield didn’t impress much either. Their substitutes like Coman didn’t make an impact. Musiala should have come earlier. Bayern’s game management was not great. But Barca’s plan worked. With only 40% possession, they played mostly on the counter and were lethal. We usually associate this word with Madrid, but Barca showed it here. They were clinical.

They opened Bayern from both sides. Two goals came in a similar way. It is important to understand that no matter how much possession they have, this team is clinical. And today, they didn’t even have their main striker Lewandowski fully involved. So this is very important to note. What I saw from Yamal today, even Messi did not have such a start. At 17, he has already won the Euros and is performing against big teams.

Nobody could stop him. You cannot take the ball away from him easily. Gnabry struggled against him. Pedri and Yamal were playing at such a high level that even in the 2011 treble-winning Barca team, they would have had a place. I am not joking. If Xavi was watching this, he would say these players could play in our era. They are performing at that level.

I would also like to praise Cubarsi. He was exceptional. This offside trap will not always work, and sometimes they need to recover quickly. Cubarsi’s recovery speed and positioning were excellent. This comes from training. Whether you like it or not, this is their plan. Madrid might exploit it, but Barca are executing it with confidence.

This was not a perfect game. Madrid will analyze this and look for weaknesses. But Barca managed the second half well. They brought Frenkie de Jong to control possession. Fermín López came in and scored. Hansi Flick’s in-game management was good. There was no immaturity. Bayern, however, made multiple changes at once, which felt strange. But overall, this shows Flick’s experience.
This is the team. Do you understand? This is Barca. Are you happy? Are you happy? Yes, yes, yes. Let’s meet in the next video.
